column2: The quality indicator is a measure of the coefficient of variation and may be adjusted to take into account the imputation rate. Quality indicator: Code A=Excellent (coefficient of variation less than or equal to 5%). Code B=Very good (coefficient of variation greater than 5%, but less than or equal to 10%). Code C=Good (coefficient of variation greater than 10%, but less than or equal to 16.5%). Code D=Fair (coefficient of variation greater than 16.5%, but less than or equal to 25%). Code E=Poor (coefficient of variation greater than 25%).
